title: Baba Mohan Goes to Delhi With Tribute and Anxiety

blocks.text: A new Malwa episode opens with political aftershocks from Chattarsal's death. Elders fear imperial retaliation, and the discussion turns toward appeasement, diplomacy, and the difficult question of how a vulnerable settlement can survive inside Mughal space.

Baba Mohan therefore steps forward with a plain proposal: he will go to Delhi. He prepares offerings, travels to court, and finds that even a clever presentation can expose him to new pressures once the queen notices what he has brought.
The page is about courage under uncertainty rather than triumph. Mohan goes not as conqueror but as negotiator, carrying fear, tribute, and reliance on the Guru into the imperial center.
